fields.description: The current state of the order. "active" – the medication is currently in use. "completed" means that the medication has been discontinued or removed from the patient's chart. Currently supported: active | completed

fields.name: intent
fields.description: Patient-reported medications are flagged as "plan". Medications prescribed by One Medical are flagged as "order". Currently supported: plan | order

fields.name: category
fields.description: Indicates where the medication is expected to be consumed. Other providers may use this to indicate inpatient vs outpatient. Binding: medicationRequest Category Codes

fields.name: .text
fields.description: Supported value: "community". This indicates that the medication will be taken in the patient's home.

fields.name: subject

fields.name: authoredOn

fields.name: requestor
fields.description: The clinician who ordered the prescription or added the medication to the patient's chart

fields.description: Provides the clincian's FHIR ID. Will be formatted as "Practitioner/9145c19l-ckfa-12db-2341-b644j45218c3"

fields.name: dosageInstruction

fields.name: .text

fields.name: reportedBoolean

fields.description: Provides the specific type of encounter (e.g. e-mail consultation, surgical day-care, skilled nursing, rehabilitation). Binding: US Core Encounter Type(extensible)

fields.description: Contains the system, code and display from a terminology system in the subfields

fields.description: The uri of the coding system. Will generally be SNOMED "http://snomed.info/sct" or CPT "http://www.ama-assn.org/go/cpt"

fields.name: .code
fields.description: The actual code number from the coding system.

fields.name: .display
fields.description: Display text from the coding system.

fields.description: Provides the member's FHIR ID. Will be formatted as "Patient/324ft342g-823e-11e9-bd76-0234kd538ce"

fields.name: participant
fields.description: Provides the clinicians who were involved in the encounter with the patient. At One Medical this will generally be the PCP or another M.D., D.O., P.A., or N.P. who saw the patient. Note: We do not currently include this in our FHIR data, but will be adding as a future enhancement.

fields.name: .individual

fields.description: Contains the reference to the provider's FHIR ID. An example is "Practitioner/12345-12345-12345-12345-12345"

fields.name: .display
fields.description: Provides the provider's first and last name in a display text field, as a quick lookup option without having to review the practitioner's FHIR record.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Provides the start and end date/time of the encounter.

fields.name: .start
fields.description: Contains the date/timestamp that the appointment started. For example "2023-03-28T08:30:00-07:00".

fields.name: .end
fields.description: Contains the date/timestamp that the appointment ended. For example "2023-03-28T09:00:00-07:00".

fields.name: location
fields.description: Provides the clinic where the encounter occurred.

fields.name: .location
fields.description: Provides the reference to the FHIR ID of the location, such as "Location/fg2ascs-jsja-44sa-ssaa-3223d32cZ987".

fields.name: diagnosis
fields.description: Provides the list of diagnoses relevant to this encounter.

fields.name: .condition
fields.description: Provides the reference to the FHIR ID of the Condition, such as "Condition/jsadf12-j00a-44sa-ssaa-3223d32ddasd2".

fields.name: .use
fields.description: The FHIR spec uses the binding DiagnosisRole (preferred). At One Medical this identifies the chief complaint / primary diagnosis for the encounter. In contrast, the secondary diagnoses, tertiary diagnoses, etc will lack the .use field.

fields.name: .code

fields.name: .display

fields.name: status
fields.description: Indicates current status of the insurance policy and whether or not it is active. Currently supported values: active | cancelled

fields.name: type
fields.description: Indicates the type of insurance. At One Medical, the policies will likely be healthcare insurance plans.

fields.name: .coding
fields.description: Contains the code, system, and display text for the insurance type

fields.name: .system
fields.description: The uri of Coverage Class valueset: "https://terminology.hl7.org/3.1.0/ValueSet-v3-ActCoverageTypeCode.html"

fields.name: .code
fields.description: The actual code number from the value set. Will likely be "HIP"

fields.name: .display
fields.description: Display text from the value set. Will likely be "health insurance plan policy"

fields.name: policyHolder
fields.description: Owner of the policy – this is akin to the "primary subscriber" on the policy.

fields.name: .reference
fields.description: Provides the subscriber's FHIR ID in One Medical's systems. Will be formatted as "Patient/324ft342g-823e-11e9-bd76-0234kd538ce" if the subscriber and beneficiary are the same, or will be formatted as "RelatedPerson/526ft342g-823e-11e9-bd76-0234kd538ce" if the beneficiary is under another person's insurance plan, such as the case with spouses and children.

fields.name: .type
fields.description: Indicates the type of resource that will be referenced. This will generally be "FHIR::Patient"

fields.name: subscriberId
fields.description: Primary subscriber ID on the insurance policy

fields.name: beneficiary
fields.description: Contains reference to the person who is the beneficiary of the policy. This may be the same as the subscriber in many cases.

fields.name: .reference
fields.description: Provides the beneficiary's FHIR ID in One Medical's systems. Will be formatted as "Organization/252ss342g-823e-11e9-bd76-0234kd538ce"

fields.name: .type
fields.description: Indicates the type of resource that will be referenced. This will generally be "FHIR::Patient"

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: Identifies the relationship of the beneficiary to the primary subscriber.

fields.name: .coding
fields.description: Contains the code, system, and display text for the insurance type

fields.name: .system
fields.description: The uri of the [SubscriberPolicyholder Relationship Codes][link-subscriber-relationship] valueset: "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/subscriber-relationship"

fields.name: .code
fields.description: The actual code number from the value set. The values One Medical uses are: self | spouse | child | other

fields.name: .display
fields.description: Display text from the value set. Will be one of these four display values: Self | Spouse | Child | Other

fields.name: period
fields.description: Contains start and end date/times of the policy. For active policies there will only be a start date.

fields.name: .start
fields.description: Provides the date/time that the policy went into effect and was active. Example: "2021-07-01T00:00:00-07:00"

fields.name: payor
fields.description: Contains reference to the Organization FHIR ID representing the insurance company / payor

fields.name: .reference
fields.description: Provides the insurer's FHIR ID in One Medical's systems. Will be formatted as "Organization/252ss342g-823e-11e9-bd76-0234kd538ce"

fields.name: .type
fields.description: Indicates the type of resource that will be referenced. This will generally be "FHIR::Organization"

fields.name: order
fields.description: Identifies whether this policy is primary, secondary, tertiary coverage, etc. A value of "1" indicates this is the member's primary insurance policy, a "2" indicates secondary coverage, a "3" indicates tertiary coverage, etc
